goal: Thin Signals returns a live query with sources, an exclusion registry and ZDR OpenRouter extraction

criteria.description: Repeating the same query returns the same PostgreSQL run id and does not search again
POST /v1/runs returns sources, signal label, run status and the exclusion registry as separate fields
The Russian screen shows signal label and run status separately, plus sources and the shortfall
Product extraction uses the OpenRouter ZDR allowlist and rejects a model outside that list

instructions.text: OpenRouter is allowed only with zdr=true and data_collection=deny. Do not call a model that is off the allowlist or has no ZDR endpoint.
GOAL v3 stays in the backend goal-kernel. The product keeps only TS-INV-01..03. Do not embed a second goal daemon.
